basics.name: Kunal Lad
basics.title: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary:
ML Technical Lead, with expertise in transforming nascent ideas into production grade AI powered products and infrastructure. I thrive in navigating the entire product lifecycle, from identifying critical challenges to designing, building, and scaling innovative AI solutions from the ground up.

Deep hands-on experience in key Generative AI paradigms, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), synthetic data generation, Post Training, developing intelligent AI Agents with robust Tool Use and ensuring reliability through Agentic Evals.

education.area: Master of Science in Computer Science (GPA 3.85/4.0)

education.institution: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

work.name: Google for Education
work.summary: Building LearnLM to enable transformative educational journeys on Gemini and other surfaces like Search, YouTube, and Classroom. [Blog] [Paper]
highlights: Led key projects in development of Learning Coach Agent in Gemini. The agent effectively plans and monitors the progress, manages cognitive load by providing relevant, well-structured information, while stimulating curiosity and adjusting dynamically to individual learner needs. [Blog] [Video]
Designed a RAG extension in Gemini for generating responses grounded in OpenStax textbooks. [Blog] [Video]
Built the Break It Down feature in AI Overviews on Google Search. [Blog] [Video]

work.name: Google AI
highlights: Drove multi-quarter effort to launch personalized recipe recommendations on Google Search improving user experience and positive metrics. [Blog]

Led the development of AI infrastructure for RL training and interactive video applications, directly enabling the success of multiple 0 to 1 projects in Google AI new products team. [SeedRL], [MoveNet]

work.name: Caspar AI
work.summary: As an early team member (10th engineer), I led several projects (focus on Computer Vision and infrastructure) and helped scale the product by 3 orders of magnitude to smart apartments across US and Japan and in process grew from Software Engineer III to Senior Software Engineer. Refer to work summary for details.
highlights: Led Awareness team responsible for rolling out multiple features to 1000+ apartments across US and Japan.

Led Caspar Concepts team, demonstrating futuristic capabilities of Caspar AI at different conferences like CEATech 2018, CES 2019 and showroom apartments. These efforts resulted in this [Patent] and multi-million dollar revenues and signing up real estate and tech partners.
